html:
Given two valid ISO dates YYYY-MM-DD, return signed days from first to second using the datetime standard library.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "2028-02-28",
    "2028-03-01"
  ],
  "expected": 2
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "2026-11-03",
    "2026-11-01"
  ],
  "expected": -2
}
Hint

Subtract date objects instead of estimating month lengths.

Complexity: O(1) time and space for fixed-size date inputs
